The Annual Collection for this good cause takes place this weekend of the Feast of Christ the King. A contribution to the Ossory Priests Society collection is an opportunity to show appreciation for the many years of service our sick and retired priests have given to God and to His people throughout the Diocese of Ossory. Sun 22nd Joe O’Mahony, Joan Butler Feast Days This Week Monday St. Margaret of Scotland St. Gertrude Tuesday St. Elizabeth of Hungary, religious Wednesday The Dedication of the Basilicas of SS Peter and Paul Saturday Presentation Of The Blessed Virgin Mary November Reflection It is again November and souls are waiting there, Yes waiting for your coming With a needy little prayer; And you promised – yes you promised in the country and the town that you would at least remember them when the leaves are coming down.
May they rest in peace Remembering Our Loved Ones Who Have Died During the month of November we pray for all the
faithful departed
including our parishioners, family members, neighbours, friends and all who have no one to remember them.
Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, let perpetual light shine upon them.
May their souls and all the souls of the faithful departed, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.
Amen. November The Month Of Holy Souls “It is a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead that they may be loosed form their sins.” (2 Maccabees 12:46).
Each November, the Church engages in a great crusade of prayer for our dead.
We pray for our dead because we believe there is a communion - an unbreakable link - between the living and the dead.
That link ensures us that we can help them and they can help us.
One saint said that the Holy Souls may win astounding favours for us and deliver us from evils, sickness and dangers of every kind.
Our prayer, especially the holy sacrifice of the Mass, is the greatest expression of our gratitude and love for those who have died.
In fact, the November Novena of Masses is the most powerful way to honour with great respect the memory of our dead.
Our prayers will enrich their eternal happiness and their concern for us will enhance our pilgrim lives.
You are encouraged to attend Mass, as often as you can, during the month of November for the Holy Souls.
